tool.name: hubCheck
tool.description: find errors in a UCSC track hub
tool.command: #if $source.source_type == 'dataset' hub_txt="\$(find -L '$source.hub.extra_files_path' -name hub.txt)" && if [ "\$(printf '%s\n' "\$hub_txt" | grep -c .)" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'The hub dataset must contain exactly one hub.txt file.' >&2; exit 1; fi && #else hub_txt='$source.url' && #end if hubCheck -udcDir=udc_cache $no_tracks "\$hub_txt" > '$report' || { rc=\$?; cat '$report' >&2; exit \$rc; } && { [ -s '$report' ] || echo 'hubCheck found no problems.' > '$report'; }

param.name: hub
param.label: Track hub
param.help: A directory that contains hub.txt and the files it refers to. To make one, upload a tar or zip archive of the hub.

validator.message: Enter an http, https or ftp URL

param.name: no_tracks
param.label: Skip the track data files
param.help: Check only hub.txt, genomes.txt and trackDb.txt. This is faster.

tool.help:
**What it does**
hubCheck finds errors in a UCSC [track hub](https://genome.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/help/hgTrackHubHelp.html) or [assembly hub](https://genome.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/help/hubQuickStartAssembly.html). Use it before you load a hub into the UCSC Genome Browser or publish it.
hubCheck starts at hub.txt. It reads genomes.txt and each trackDb.txt, then opens the data file of each track. It reports errors in these files, track data files that are not valid, and missing description pages.
-----
**Input**
- **Dataset in my history**: a hub as a directory dataset. Upload a tar or zip archive of the hub folder, and Galaxy converts it to a directory. The tool also accepts a trackhub dataset. The dataset must contain exactly one hub.txt file. Relative paths in the hub must point to files in the same dataset. - **Public URL**: the URL of the hub.txt file on a web server.
**Output**
A text report. If hubCheck finds a problem, the report lists it and the job fails. The job error message also shows the report. Warnings, for example a missing description page, also make the job fail.
-----
**More information**
- [hubCheck source code](https://github.com/ucscGenomeBrowser/kent/tree/master/src/hg/utils/hubCheck)
